intitule: Cybersecurity and Digital Sovereignty Project Manager
accroche: With a technical background and as a French Army reserve officer, I connect public-sector missions, cybersecurity and the teams that deliver.
resume: I have been a senior project manager at Capgemini since 2020, running digital projects for French government ministries and the public sector: application development, cyber risk assessments, architecture studies and sovereign solutions. I have led more than 30 projects worth €500k to over €5M, bringing together teams of 5 to 15 people.

Sovereignty sits at the heart of this work. The question is whether to use a SecNumCloud-qualified trusted cloud or an on-premise deployment at the client's site, and then to back that choice with a risk assessment the decision-makers can follow. I take each engagement from scoping to delivery and I am accountable for the client, the budget, the contract and the teams.

A French Army reserve officer since 2017, I currently serve as a communications adviser and have used these skills on an overseas operation. It gives me an inside view of the missions my projects serve. From technical training in electrical engineering and computing, followed by business school, I kept a method I put to work for my clients: understand their mission, talk technology with the teams and report plainly to decision-makers.

langues.niveau: Fluent, after a year of study in Mexico
